## sla_escalation: You're not responding or not performing

Goal: Acknowledge the escalation directly, own any miss, and give one concrete step for this shift.

Check first:
- Earlier tickets from this merchant and how long they've been open.

Situations:
- When: A repeat ask. Reply: Name the earlier ticket, apologise once, and answer it now if the context allows. Action item: escalate_to_account_manager.
- When: A complaint about our performance. Reply: Own the miss in facts, without defensiveness. Action item: escalate_to_account_manager.
- When: "Let me speak to your manager". Reply: A member of our team will reach out directly. Action item: escalate_to_account_manager.

Never:
- Quote SLA numbers.

Not decided yet. If the reply needs one of these, write "let me confirm with the team":
- The named contact by merchant tier, and whether to include a phone number. Don't name a person.
